modelOverride.label: Model override
modelOverride.helper: Pinned automatically by tier; override only if needed.

voiceList.label: Voice
voiceList.noVoices: No voices available for this combination.

brandKit.label: Brand kit
brandKit.helper: Replaces palette, fonts, layout, intro / outro, and watermark for this generation.

reviewMode.label: Review script first
reviewMode.helper: Edit the AI-generated script before audio and visuals are created.

subShots.label: Sub-shot split
subShots.helper: Splits dense, motion-heavy shots into 2 focused sub-shots before HTML generation. Better visual precision; small extra LLM cost.

dialogueScenes.label: Story dialogue scenes
dialogueScenes.helper: Characters act out key moments in AI-generated clips, speaking in consistent voices (lip-synced). Adds generation cost per scene.

storybook.label: Storybook
storybook.description: Narrator carries the video; 1-4 dialogue scenes at key moments.

drama.label: Drama
drama.description: Pure dialogue film — every shot is a scene, no narrator, music off. Higher clip budget.

seedance.label: Seedance 2.0
seedance.description: Voice-locked: characters lip-sync to our TTS — same voices every scene and sequel. ~$0.30/s, clips up to 15s.

omniFlash.label: Omni Flash
omniFlash.description: Gemini Omni speaks the lines itself — ~2x cheaper (~$0.13/s) but voices may vary between scenes. Clips up to 10s.

castPicker.noSavedCasts: New characters this video. Finish a story, then “Save cast” to reuse them in the next one.
castPicker.label: Cast

aiVideo.label: AI video generation
aiVideo.tierLocked: Available on Ultra and Super Ultra tiers only. Switch tier above to enable.
aiVideo.description: Generates cinematic clips with fal.ai Veo. ≈{{minCredits}}–{{maxCredits}} credits per shot, hard-capped at {{capCredits}} per video. Director picks when content fits.
aiVideo.audioCostNote: When ON, AI video shots play their own audio. Master narration is silenced during those shots. Cost rises from {{offRate}} credits/s to {{onRate}} credits/s.

visualPreferences.label: Visual mix
visualPreferences.hint: Soft hints only. Free-text phrases in your prompt (e.g. “more SVG diagrams”) override these.
visualPreferences.directorHint: On <tier>{{tierLabel}}</tier>, family bias is applied via the script. Director-level bias starts at Premium.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Detect from topic — marketing looks premium, lessons stay clean.

educational.label: Clean
educational.description: Flat whiteboard look. Best for lessons & explainers.

marketing.label: Premium
marketing.description: Modern brand-film look: depth, motion, finishing, minimal text.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Title-only on hooks. No body anywhere.

visualPreferences.captionsHint: Captions are recommended at this density — your video will rely on narration to carry meaning.

locked.title: On-screen host requires Ultra
locked.description: The Host feature (AI avatar narrator) is available on <ultra>Ultra</ultra> and <superUltra>Super Ultra</superUltra> tiers only. Switch the Quality tier in the Output tab to enable it.

staleConfig.title: Saved host config will be ignored
staleConfig.description: You have a host configuration saved from a higher tier. It will cause this generation to fail unless you switch back to Ultra or clear it now.

enableToggle.label: Enable on-screen host
enableToggle.helper: A talking-head host appears in some shots and narrates in 1st person. Costs {{rate}} credits/sec of host footage on top of the base video.

avatarPicker.label: Host avatar
avatarPicker.helper: Pick from your saved hosts. Built-in catalog avatars (Argil / VEED) lock the model to their endpoint.

useSavedVoice.label: Use avatar’s saved voice
useSavedVoice.helper: On: voice / language / gender from the saved avatar override the Voice tab. Off: keep the Voice tab’s settings.

details.label: Host details (clothing, persona)
details.helper: Free-form. Threaded into every per-shot avatar image prompt for consistency.
details.placeholder: e.g. navy blazer, neutral office background, professional demeanour

faceUpload.label: Host face image
faceUpload.helper: Clear, front-facing portrait. Used as the per-shot identity reference.
faceUpload.dropHint: Click or drop a face photo (PNG / JPG, ≤10 MB)

errors.invalidType: Please pick an image file (PNG / JPG).

quality.label: Avatar quality
quality.helper: Same per-second price; 720p produces a heavier file.

fps.label: Frames per second
fps.helper: Higher fps = smoother motion and a higher per-second cost. LTX 2.3 only.

percentage.label: Host on screen — {{percent}}%
percentage.helper: Director picks which shots show the host (Hook, Recap, CTA, high-emphasis beats are prioritised). Narration audio plays continuously regardless.
percentage.tip: Tip: Below ~25% the host barely appears — disable Host instead to save on avatar synthesis costs.

brandOverride.title: Override for this video
brandOverride.intro: One-shot tweaks for this generation only — they don’t change the kit and reset after you generate.

directorInstructions.label: Director instructions
directorInstructions.placeholderReplace: Replace the kit instructions for this video…
directorInstructions.placeholderDefault: e.g. Make it punchier and lead with the offer.
directorInstructions.helper: Replaces the kit’s instructions for this video only.

modelOverrides.label: AI model overrides
modelOverrides.description: Pick a model for the LLM stages of this run. Leave blank to use system defaults. Vision review and small utility prompts always use system defaults to protect quality and cost.

sheet.title: Generation settings
sheet.resetTitle: Reset all settings to defaults (prompt and attachments are kept)

toggle.label: Lesson mode
toggle.helper: Teach it like a class: lesson pacing, a teacher’s voice, and an optional teacher beside the board.

teacher.label: Teacher on screen
teacher.noneHelper: Board only — the lesson is narrated, no one on screen
teacher.empty: No teacher avatars yet. Add one under AI tutor settings (Teacher presence).
teacher.cost: The teacher costs 8 credits per minute of video.

help.auto: Intro with the teacher large, explanations and recap beside the board, dense steps with the teacher in the corner.
help.presenter: The teacher stands in a panel on the right third; the board shows a title and one key line.
help.side: The board uses three quarters of the frame; the teacher stands in a slim panel on the right.
help.corner: The board gets the whole frame; the teacher is a small cut-out in the bottom-right corner.
help.bubble: The board gets the whole frame; the teacher appears in a round bubble in the bottom-right corner.
help.board: No teacher on screen; the narration still sounds like a teacher.

lesson.hostDisabled: Lesson mode has its own teacher, so the on-screen host is off. Turn off Lesson mode on the Output tab to use a host.
